text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"More controlled paragraphing with clear transitions like \"However,\" \"In addition,\" and \"In summarize,\"","quality":"organizational control","description":"This captures how the essay is arranged into recognizable parts with signposted movement between ideas."},{"evidence":"Sustained attempts at multi-sentence explanation of goals and success","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures the ability to extend a central point with elaboration rather than only brief statements."},{"evidence":"Use of varied academic vocabulary such as \"essential,\" \"opportunities,\" \"obstacle,\" and \"communication\"","quality":"lexical range","description":"This captures having a broader and more formal word choice than the other essay."},{"evidence":"More complex sentence frames like \"if we can protrude means that we have more opportunities\"","quality":"syntactic complexity","description":"This captures attempts to build longer, more layered sentence structures instead of mostly simple clauses."}]}
